mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are enjoying clear skies and a pleasant temperature of 73 degrees at Harriet Park, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an engineering technician to oversee public works projects, and residents are reminded that sewer and stormwater utility rates have been adjusted to keep our essential systems self-supporting.

It is a busy time in our city! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, with a free Girls Try Hockey event coming up tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
Regarding local activity, on Friday, August 15, officers responded to a situation where a 44-year-old driver was found passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.
Be sure to stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Raspberry Cheesecake, before they close their doors at 10:30 PM.
